entities.name: Lord
entities.description: Slang for a creature that boosts other creatures sharing a creature type; also a retired creature type for high-ranking creatures.

entities.description: One of the first three lords, printed in Alpha.

entities.name: Lord of Atlantis
entities.description: One of the first three lords, printed in Alpha.

entities.name: Zombie Master
entities.description: One of the first three lords and the only one originally printed with the Lord type.

entities.name: Brady Dommermuth
entities.description: R&D member who decided to eliminate the Lord type for Tenth Edition.

events.summary: The Lord creature type is retired with Tenth Edition after lengthy debate.
events.quote: The creature type Lord was retired with the printing of Tenth Edition .

events.summary: Brady Dommermuth decides to eliminate the Lord type, counting on players using Lord as slang.
events.quote: I'm intending to go with the "cut the Gordian knot" option: eliminate the Lord type.
